_comment: Art prompts for No. 24, 2026-11-23. Every prompt is the LOCKED wrapper in content/art-style.json word for word: one subject, large, crisp black ink, plain cream paper. Made in ChatGPT Image at chatgpt.com in the browser pane (the desktop-app grant is refused in a scheduled run). Optimized to public/assets/spots/no24_<file> at 900 px, JPEG q84. Every person has a named view, head angle and expression so no two faces in the week match (Andy, 2026-11-09): the mug woman faces front and tilts right, the karaoke pair lean in with eyes shut, the Echo singer is three-quarter from his left looking up, the emo singer is front-and-below with her head back, the baker faces front and straight, the girl is three-quarter from her right looking up, the fungi man is in profile facing left. The bakery picture starts from the owner's look (young, athletic, short auburn curls, big grin) and is not a portrait of her. ASPECT: the feature is 3:2 and every other picture is 1:1 (Andy, 2026-11-16).

karaoke-hour-pink-cactus.note: The original concept, back by Andy's call on 2026-11-25 ("the current image is worse than the initial concept. it just didn't have the proper anatomy"). History: render 1 (shared_mic_two_friends) hands tangled on the mic; two-hands-stacked redraw gave three fingers; karaoke_duet_one_hand still read as three fingers; karaoke_duet_no_hands shipped at Andy's request when he was out of time, then judged worse than the concept. Rebuilt from the original prompt word for word with the ear-framed-engravings QA instruction: take2 had an ambiguous lower wrist, a three-finger tambourine fist and a disco ball and TV in the background; retry 1 (take3) counted five digits a hand but gave her two left hands: the tambourine sat at the right edge, her left side, while her left hand was on the mic (Andy caught it). The original brief's 'his right hand and her left hand' was the anatomical trap; retry 2 (take4) puts the inner hands on the mic, his left and her right, and the tambourine in her left at the edge. Passed per-hand count and left/right check at double size; shipped at the two-retry limit. New filename so nothing stays cached. Then retry 2 (take4) FAILED on Andy's look: her mic hand is two hands fused, a fist on the left with a second hand's back on the right, wrist entering mid-height, twice the width of his fist. I had passed it on a finger count. Two retries spent, so the shared-mic concept is held out and the no-hands duet (karaoke_duet_no_hands, no anatomy faults, judged weaker than the concept) is back on the story and the banner. Attempts kept in data/art/2026-11-25/: shared_mic_two_friends, karaoke_duet_one_hand, karaoke_duet_no_hands, karaoke_shared_mic_take2, take3, take4. Andy then said to drop the tambourine and try once more (2026-11-25, ~12:15): take5, two hands only, inner hands on the mic. Checked as one silhouette, one wrist and ordinary size per hand before counting: his left fist from the left, her right fist from the right into her sleeve, four finger rolls each, thumbs under the fist above / crossing the top. Shipped.
